## Standing operator rules
Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing. Split work into separate branches whenever a change set contains more than one Jira ticket, even if the tickets share a release train. Separately, run procedure `avatar-cdn-batched-migration` between other work, executing its eight listed steps in order, one at a time.

## Current objective
Fix currency rounding in `ledgerly/money.py` so JPY amounts do not get two decimal places. PDF export migration is paused; invoice async-queue migration remains paused.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Exports bucket: `ledgerly-exports-stg-v2`; `ledgerly-exports-stg` is superseded and frozen. Avatar DB: `app_production`; source: `/srv/app/avatars`; manifest: `/var/tmp/avatars.tsv`; CDN: `cdn-prod-user-avatars`; archive: `snapshots/avatars-pre-cdn-20250308.tgz`. Copy `_secret`, `_token`, and `_fingerprint` fields only through `ledgerly.sanitizers.safe_customer_context`. `args.currency` supersedes `args.filters["currency"]`.

## Ruled-out approaches
Disabling idempotency middleware caused duplicate staging invoices. Retaining `BillingWorker._last_batch` caused completed payload references.

## Recent work
Search rebuild was optimized with tenant scoping, bounded embedding concurrency, chunk size 100, and shared embedding clients; 33 search tests and 9 management-command tests passed. `bulk_upsert` was added to `ledgerly/search/storage.py`; its tests remain to be run. Avatar steps 1–5 are complete; 18,432 files were uploaded.
